items.text: Accented letters are reduced to their plain ASCII letter instead of being dropped.
Any run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits becomes exactly one hyphen.
The slug has no leading or trailing hyphen, and an input with nothing usable returns an empty string.
The fix uses the standard library only and keeps the slugify(title) signature.

nonIssues: The existing tests in test_textutil.py are wrong or need changing.
slugify should raise an error on empty input.
